title: Exercise 1.1 · Q2
summary: Represent the following numbers on number line: (i) √2 (ii) √3 (iii) 4 1/3 (iv) −2 1/7 (v) 5/8 (vi) 2 3/4

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(Rehan adds the diagrams later — construction steps are given.)}\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{(i) }\mathbf{\sqrt{2}:}}\text{ On the number line take O}\\[5pt]&\quad =0\text{ and }A=1.\text{ At A draw AB }=1\text{ unit}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{perpendicular to OA.}\\[5pt]&(OB)^{2}=(OA)^{2}+(AB)^{2}=(1)^{2}+\\[5pt]&\quad (1)^{2}=2\\[5pt]&\Rightarrow OB=\sqrt{2}\\[5pt]&\text{With centre O and radius OB draw an}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{arc cutting the number line at P. P}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{represents }\sqrt{2}.\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{(ii) }\mathbf{\sqrt{3}:}}\text{ First locate }P=\sqrt{2}\text{ as in}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(i), so OP }=\sqrt{2}.\text{ At P draw PQ }=1\text{ unit}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{perpendicular to the number line.}\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Result
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&(OQ)^{2}=(OP)^{2}+(PQ)^{2}=(\sqrt{2})^{2}+\\[5pt]&\quad (1)^{2}=2+1=3\\[5pt]&\Rightarrow OQ=\sqrt{3}\\[5pt]&\text{With centre O and radius OQ draw an}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{arc cutting the number line at R. R}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{represents }\sqrt{3}.\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{(iii) }\mathbf{4\frac{1}{3}=\frac{13}{3}:}}\text{ It lies}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{between }4\text{ and }5.\text{ Divide the unit}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{segment from }4\text{ to }5\text{ into }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{3}}\text{ equal}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{parts; the }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{1st}}\text{ division point to}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{the right of }4\text{ represents }4\frac{1}{3.}\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{(iv) }\mathbf{-2\frac{1}{7}=-\frac{15}{7}:}}\text{ It lies}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{between }-3\text{ and }-2\text{ (to the left of }-2).\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Divide the segment from }-3\text{ to }-2\text{ into}\\[5pt]&\quad \textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{7}}\text{ equal parts; the point }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{1}\textbf{ part}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{to the left of }-2\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(i.e. the }6th\text{ mark from }-3)\text{ represents}\\[5pt]&\quad -2\frac{1}{7.}\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{(v) }\mathbf{\frac{5}{8}:}}\text{ It lies between }0\text{ and }1.\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Divide the unit segment from }0\text{ to }1\\[5pt]&\quad \text{into }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{8}}\text{ equal parts; the }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{5th}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{division point from }0\text{ represents }\frac{5}{8.}\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{(vi) }\mathbf{2\frac{3}{4}=\frac{11}{4}:}}\text{ It lies between}\\[5pt]&\quad 2\text{ and }3.\text{ Divide the segment from }2\text{ to}\\[5pt]&\quad 3\text{ into }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{4}}\text{ equal parts; the }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{3rd}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{division point to the right of }2\\[5pt]&\quad \text{represents }2\frac{3}{4.}\end{aligned}\]
